CPU: Dual AMD EPYC™ 7003/7002 Series Processors (The latest AMD EPYC™ 7003 Series Processor with AMD 3D V-Cache™ Technology requires BIOS version 2.3 or newer)

Memory Capacity: Supports up to 8TB Registered ECC DDR4 3200MHz SDRAM
For Dual CPUs: Recommended that memory be populated equally in adjacent memory banks
Memory Type: DDR4 3200 MHz Registered ECC, 288-pin gold-plated DIMMs

IPMI: Support for Intelligent Platform Management Interface v. 2.0
IPMI 2.0 with virtual media over LAN and KVM-over-LAN support
Network Controllers: Flexible networking provided by AIOM via AIOM Adapter (AOM-438G-AIOM)
Dedicated IPMI via I/O riser card

LAN: 1 RJ45 dedicated IPMI port via I/O Riser card ( AOM-DGO-IO )
USB: 2 USB 3.0 ports via I/O riser card (AOM-DGO-IO)
VGA: 1 VGA port via I/O riser card (AOM-DGO-IO)
Others: 2 internal NVMe (PCI-E 4.0 x4) ports via 1 SlimSAS (PCI-E 4.0 x8)

Power Configurations: Power-on mode control for AC power loss recovery
